tools.name: vector.info
tools.description: Inspect a vector document in your workspace (an SVG, a .vectorcraft file or another format the engine opens): artboards, the layer tree to `depth` levels (default 2, at most 8; every cut level reports its child count), object count, colour mode, units and import warnings. Reads only. `path` is relative to your workspace, the folder your own file tools (list_dir, read_file) see; files outside it cannot be named. A document that links a file outside your workspace is refused.

tools.name: vector.run
tools.description: Run up to 64 commands from the vector engine's catalog, in order, on the document at `path` (SVG, .vectorcraft or another format the engine opens) in your workspace, or on a new default document, then write it in the format `format` or the extension of `out` names (SVG/SVGZ, PDF, EPS, DXF, EMF/WMF, PNG/JPG/WebP/GIF/TIFF/BMP/TGA/PSD or .vectorcraft; raster output is one artboard, `artboard` 0-based, sized by `scale` 0.01 to 16 pixels per point) to `out` when given. Each command is {id, params}. Only reviewed commands run: those the skill's commands.md lists untagged (work inside the document) and effects the engine builds in (never a plug-in); anything that reaches other files, code, the network, devices or the app is refused before any command runs. Paths are relative to your workspace, and `out` must be a new file. Read the vector-engine skill first.
